meaning: Re-measurement of the Hugging Face census snapshot on the tree named below at two rulesets, with the blockers in the Model Onboarding buckets and two denominators. A header/shape census: nothing here is a registration, and the registered column is evidence-bound.
estimator: hf-census-v1 §4/§4b: exact counts over the baseline-decided repositories by the current listing verdict; Horvitz–Thompson over the stratified header sample (n = 1,773); the three baseline bucket cohorts (n = 150 each) post-stratified by the exact current-listing verdict of their frames; one-sided 95% Korn–Graubard lower bounds; the plain cohort expansion of update 2 is reported beside it (`plain_method`). Shape-depth judgment of every sampled repository; no repository without a row is dropped (nonresponse = UNTESTED).
denominator_b_rule: D_b = D_all minus every repository whose primary blocker is external: MISSING_WEIGHTS (no weight file, an incomplete shard set, an unreachable repository, an unreadable header), GATED (gated or disabled), ADAPTER_BASE_MISSING (an adapter whose base is absent, ambiguous, not in the snapshot or gated), NO_MODEL_TASK (no declared task and no configuration naming a model class, or no readable configuration). The listing-decided part is exact from the snapshot; the header-decided part is estimated from the sample.

top_args: a decoder adapter for the text decoder of `Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration`

top_software_closable_blockers.family: NLU heads (classification / token / QA / fill-mask)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: a canonical job profile for encoder heads: label / span / token logits as the committed output, the label set in the class (the frontend already lowers a sequence classifier as an Embedding-profile class); a `tasks.rs` row per head + one RFC-0003 profile

top_software_closable_blockers.family: RL / robotics / tabular / time series / video / graph
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: no importer for these frameworks (SB3 zips, sklearn, torch pickles) and no canonical job: a per-family profile each; the least generic of the closable blockers

top_software_closable_blockers.family: PyTorch `pytorch_model.bin` (zip directory + pickle not read)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: a bounded range read of the zip central directory and `data.pkl` (no weights, no pickle execution): outside the 10-03 network policy (headers of safetensors/GGUF only) — a policy decision, then `weights::torchzip` already reads it

top_software_closable_blockers.family: GGUF files carrying a foreign metadata namespace (`mradermacher.*`, uploader bookkeeping)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: a data registry of inert provenance namespaces for GGUF metadata (quantizer / uploader keys change no math; a namespace that declares a transform, like `prism.hadamard`, stays refused)

top_software_closable_blockers.family: vision-chat / any-to-any (the text stage lowers, the other stage is not credited)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: tower adapters for the wrappers in the census (Qwen3.5, Gemma 3/4, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-NeXT, Florence-2, Mistral3, Mllama) + the generative close sizing for a tower (`palw_gen_range_twin_v1` / tile-class sizing) + arming `palw_gen_v1`'s Text profile with image slots; Qwen2/2.5-VL at 196 px already admits under the dormant fences

top_software_closable_blockers.family: audio tasks (ASR / TTS / audio classification)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: a `JobAudio` binding (FR-23: feature frames) and an audio output kind: the Whisper / wav2vec2 stage programs lower, no protocol job supplies frames

top_software_closable_blockers.family: vision heads (classification / detection / segmentation / dense)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: the CNN / ViT route (`read_cnn`, `read_vision`) exists as stage programs: needs RFC-0003 Image-input job profiles for class labels, boxes and masks (JobImage is bound) and their output kinds

top_software_closable_blockers.family: a model class with no declared task (`pipeline_tag` absent)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: task inference from the remaining head classes and from `architectures` (inference-v3 reads causal LM, T5, vision-chat, sentence encoders, adapter bases); a head-class → task table row per family

top_software_closable_blockers.family: weights only as onnx / tensorflow / flax / pytorch-adapter / split GGUF
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: an ONNX initializer reader and a TF/Flax checkpoint reader (headers by range), a split-GGUF reader, an `adapter_model.bin` reader

top_software_closable_blockers.family: no tokenizer file beside the checkpoint
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: bind the tokenizer of the pinned base (vocab size checked)

top_software_closable_blockers.family: diffusers UNet denoisers (skip connections over convolutions)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: a UNet route: concatenating skip connections + spatial transformers lowered as stage programs (`GEN_UNET_SKIP_V1`), with the Image-profile job already in RFC-0003

top_software_closable_blockers.family: a LoRA the attach refuses (GGUF LoRA, rank/target forms)
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: GGUF LoRA composition and the remaining PEFT target forms in `lora::attach`

top_software_closable_blockers.family: an embedding / image / encoder-alone class: the pipeline admission cannot be asked from headers
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: a shape-only Embedding- and Image-profile class declaration (the encoder-decoder's `preflight::pipeline` is the model)

top_software_closable_blockers.family: `trust_remote_code` architectures
top_software_closable_blockers.generic_change_that_would_close_it: a data adapter for each remote-code family that is a combination of known features (never repository code)

registration_columns.rule: Each column is its own count. Only the last, registered_full_task_active_or_final, is a registration in the RFC-0011 §7 sense: an accepted on-chain class registration (or an independently verified reuse of the same class id and artifact root) for the repository's complete advertised task at its declared context, that reached Active/Final under the armed rules. A similar model name never counts.
